identifier: Two answers the person gave microscope-20260924-6 on the evening of 2026-09-24: which Kinetix body the Tweez 300 software opens ('The red-arm body'), and whether it can save frames ('we always release the camera, and you cannot see anything on the tweezer software'). Quoted verbatim in the message of commit 20387f0.
grade_rule: E5: stated from knowledge, not read off an instrument when asked. A serial read from the tweezers software would supersede the first at a higher grade.
what_was_not: a model's estimate of trap-well depth made in the same exchange, which the microscope seat kept out as a model's number.
